name: wave
description: WAVE fleet secret shapes missed by the built-in pipeline (canary-proven 2026-08-14: Doppler dp.* and AWS AKIA shapes passed through 0.10.0's 6 always-on layers). v1.0.1: dropped the standalone 40-char Cloudflare rule — it matched 40-hex git SHAs (review finding); CF tokens in assignment context are covered by generic-credential-kv, and standalone CF tokens are caught by the built-in entropy layer (mixed-case 40-char strings exceed the Shannon>4.5 bar while lowercase hex SHAs sit under it). Committed samples are negative-only so even decoy-shaped strings never land in git.

samples.input: see the doppler docs; dp.pt alone is not a token
short dp.pt.abc123 is below the length floor
